note: GBA/GBC needs-evidence items (frozen at B7). Narrow: each names the single piece of missing evidence and the disposition rule once it is supplied.

items.what: One side-by-side sheet: Crystal gfx/battle_anims/angels.png frames for the IMP, CHERUB and DESTINY_BOND framesets next to key frames of Platinum lovely_kiss, sweet_kiss, spite, nightmare (Func_Nightmare sprites) and destiny_bond particle/sprite resources (5 moves, key frames only).
items.why: Script-level comparison cannot show whether Platinum already has a recurring character-style motif for these moves; that is the only open question.
items.disposition_rule: If no Platinum frame shows a comparable recurring figure, reclassify to novel_detail (redraw Platinum-native, pixel_use none). If Platinum already shows an equal or better figure/motif, reclassify to reference_only. Rendering is limited to these five moves; do not extend to other banks.
items.decision: Closure (B4.5) skipped by project decision at B7; not resolved, not blocking, excluded from ranking.

resolved.outcome: all six generic families reference_only (Platinum equivalent or better)

deferred_not_blocking.what: Measure OAM and sub/main palette headroom in the battle scene (single and double battle, during move animations) before committing to a persistent battler glyph layer.
deferred_not_blocking.why_not_blocking: Does not change the classification: the opportunity (Platinum has no persistent battler-local indicator) is established from source; headroom only affects cost/risk at implementation planning.
deferred_not_blocking.disposition_rule: If headroom is insufficient, the record stays novel_detail with higher risk and the design phase picks a reduced glyph set; it does not become reference_only.

deferred_not_blocking.what: Ruby semantic delta against Emerald (B5) was not run.
deferred_not_blocking.why_not_blocking: Project decision. Ruby is Emerald's predecessor on the same engine; Emerald is closed with 0 promoted records, so no ranked opportunity depends on it.
deferred_not_blocking.disposition_rule: If reopened, reuse evidence/B1_EMERALD_SYMBOL_EVIDENCE.json and evidence/B1_5_PLATINUM_FLDEFF_MEMBER_NAMES.json; any Ruby-only effect matching a Platinum member already named there is reference_only.
